text:
margo: Whoa microburst at Embarcadero & Mission — crosswalk is a small lake. Phone almost went for a swim. :sweat_drops:

evan: Saw that. I offered my umbrella and someone offered a rubber duck?? Only in SF. :duck:

samir: @margo hope phone ok. I have a portable charger and a ziplock at my desk if you need to dry it out.

lina: BART announced reduced service through Embarcadero. Consider the shuttle or walking the Embarcadero promenade.

commute-bot: BART alert: "Limited service through Embarcadero due to weather-related track inspections." https://status.bart.example/2004

margo: Phone survived thanks to heroic ziplock. Also accepting rubber duck as a mascot. :heart:

evan: Quick poll — who wants a dry ride from Mission to the office? React with :bus: for ride needed, :bicycle: for biking, :walking: for walking, :car: if you can offer a seat.

samir: :car: I can take one person from 2nd & Mission. DM me.

lina: :walking: stretching my soggy legs. Also PSA grab the plastic mat by the foyer before you step in.

commute-bot: Muni: "Several routes experiencing slowdowns near Embarcadero due to standing water." Shuttle ETA 9m.

margo: Thanks everyone. Also someone put the rubber duck by the kitchen sink; it's now our official commute mascot. Please respect its tiny dignity.

evan: Duck photo incoming. If it becomes CEO we demand equity. :camera_with_flash:

weather-bot: Weather: "Heavy localized showers, possible street flooding. Expect spotty disruptions for 30-60 minutes."
